[[Gallow Nooseknitter]] is a [[ranger]] [[boss]] that causes several [[arachnid]]s to [[spawn]] when approached.

== Locations ==
*[[Tarnished Coast]]
** {{NPC location|Riven Earth}}

== Skills ==
* {{skill icon|Apply Poison}}
* {{skill icon|Crippling Shot}} ([[elite]])
* {{skill icon|Debilitating Shot}}
* {{skill icon|Hunter's Shot}}
* {{skill icon|Natural Stride}}
* {{skill icon|Troll Unguent}}

== Items dropped ==
* [[Nooseknitter's Flatbow]] ([[unique]])
* [[Weaver Leg]]

== Notes ==
* Gallow Nooseknitter was named by Will Bonner (Hustler Warrior) through the 2007 [[Eye of the North Brand the Boss (2007)|Brand The Boss]] contest.
* If you're farming this boss, you can use the portal just southeast of it to rezone and come back.

== Trivia ==
* A [[w:Gallows|gallows]] is used for executions and can include an attached rope [[w:Noose|noose]].
